description: This Java class provides helper methods for managing order status changes, including approving, rejecting, completing, and canceling orders, as well as handling inventory reservations and payments within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: OrderChangeHelper
classes.description: Helper class for performing non-read order actions such as approval, rejection, completion, and cancellation within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: approveOrder
methods.description: Approves an order, updating its status and related item statuses, optionally holding the order.

methods.name: rejectOrder
methods.description: Rejects an order, updates statuses, cancels inventory reservations, and releases payment authorizations.

methods.name: completeOrder
methods.description: Completes an order by creating payments and invoice, and updating order status.

methods.name: cancelOrder
methods.description: Cancels an order, updates statuses, cancels inventory reservations, and releases payment authorizations.

methods.name: orderStatusChanges
methods.description: Updates the order header, order items, and digital items statuses, handling errors.

methods.name: cancelInventoryReservations
methods.description: Cancels inventory reservations for the specified order.

methods.name: releasePaymentAuthorizations
methods.description: Releases payment authorizations for the specified order.

methods.name: createReceivedPayments
methods.description: Creates payment records for received payments based on order payment preferences.

methods.name: createOrderInvoice
methods.description: Creates an invoice for the specified order.
